Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa
The Bhaviṣya purāṇa consists of four parvans viz. Brāhma, Madhyama, Pratisarga an. Uttara. Among these, the Uttara Parvan consists of two hundred an. eight chapters an. is a distinct Purāṇa in itself called the Bhaviṣyottara purāṇa. This Parvan forms a supplement to the Bhaviṣya Purāṇa. It deals with different religious rites, especially the vratas.
See Prof. Pushpendra Sastri, Introduction to Purāṇas, Rashtriya Sanskrit Sansthan, New Delhi, 1995, p. 98.
See Aṣṭādaśapurāṇa by Jvālāprasādmiśra, Nag Publishers, Delhi, 1990; also Wint. HIL. Vol. I. p. 542; also [Page204-a. R. C. Hazra, The Bhaviṣyottara, A Non-Sectarian Upapurāṇa of wide popularity, J. of Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni. Baroda, p.. 8 ff.
However many vratas found here are not available in the Pt.. Ed.. of Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa (Veṅkaṭeśvara edn.). Also though some Vratas show the source a. Bhaviṣyottara, the readings vary.
